viewing_check: Turn it over and photograph any base mark or incised mould number (Royal Dux pink triangle, Von Schierholz, Sitzendorf). List all damage: chipped roses and fingers are common, cracks to the stem or bowl matter most. Check height and that the bowl sits properly.
